item: Flying wings (kerf/aero.py): airfoils from the UIUC database (catalog/airfoils, sourced) and NACA 4-digit, swept / tapered / twisted wing lofts, split into printable segments, spar-tube channels, elevon cut + hinge joint, servo bays; wing geometry (area, MAC, neutral point); checks `static_margin`, `wing_loading`, `stall_speed`, `spar_bending`, each with a hand-calculated test
